name: UWCSEA Dover
summary: IB continuum campus on Dover Road with strong service culture — campus choice (Dover vs East) is a housing decision, not a footnote.
body: United World College of South East Asia’s Dover campus runs the IB continuum in a west-central location popular with families near Holland V, Clementi, and Bukit Timah — a default shortlist when the family’s exam thesis is IB Diploma rather than British A-Level. Admissions are selective and mission-aware; the community is intentionally international. An offer at Dover is not interchangeable with UWCSEA East for commute, after-school logistics, or rental belts — treat campus as part of the written offer. Boarding options exist for eligible students and create their own wait dynamics. High demand means published application cycles matter; short-notice movers should parallel-apply elsewhere rather than underwriting rent on a hope. Ask about learning-support capacity early if relevant — inclusive reputation does not equal unlimited seats. Mid-stream DP entries face transcript mapping risk; get written Grade-level answers before resigning overseas. Families weighing weekly boarding or guardianship during regional parent travel should pressure-test pastoral duty hours — see the boarding & hostel guide for IS teens. Dual-career note: treat residential/overnight trip packing nights as blackout tasks, not optional evening chores.
waitlistNotes: High demand; applications open on published cycles. Confirm Dover vs East explicitly and ask for dated year-group availability.
